location.review: 借用原作火山地貌；局部战时舞台不改变烟囱山原有缆车、山路或海岸，不表示四地区接壤。军队如何到达留待战史。

objective.name: 中央岩台通道
objective.scope: Local tactical staging only; no new war cause, strategic resource, alliance or historical outcome.

staging.target_rule: Named reciprocal contact pairs form two central fronts and cross-region flanks; targets are justified per actor, not assigned round-robin.
formation_rules: Point and two shoulders screen two supporting units.
Commanders and partner/rescue groups remain behind their own front.
Bodies face their target or partner; moving actors face the route.
Each unit has a recorded station, purpose, target and route.

terrain_design.method: Pinned Emerald native metatile assemblies, authored local battlefield; no global geography changes.
